source: IgBEM full stress tensor on the bisector, unit nominal net stress, z/T 0.125..0.875 (thickness mean taken per measure)

measures.vm: von Mises (octahedral shear stress tau_oct*3/sqrt2 is identical)
measures.eps1: E x max principal strain = (1+nu) s1 - nu tr(s), nu 0.35
measures.syy: stress normal to the bisector (load direction)

provenance: bc_case solve of the c0 mesh of igabem_bisector_profiles.json (same d and z stations), full stress tensor at each station; s1 reproduces that file's sigma_1 to 3e-5. Mesh convergence: see igabem_bisector_profiles.json (nested c2/c1/c0, < 0.4% for d >= 0.1 mm). Solved before the solution cache existed; later probes read the stored solution.
